name: Rizuhble's Rabbit Punch Sinclair
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-6,400 (levels 1-12). 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Health
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stalker
items.caption: Temporary, sold when you buy Alchemical Fire later.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Reactive Barrier, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Have it by about 8 minutes and eat a big camp with it.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 6,400-17,600 (levels 12-24). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rabbit Hex T3, Audience Participation T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Vexing Bolt, max damage) grows from 147 to 196. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Reactive Barrier.

items.name: Fortitude
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Reactive Barrier completes 800 souls on. Upgrade of Extra Health (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.why: imminent: Reactive Barrier completes 4.8k vitality in 800 souls (~0.8 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 8k tier completes at Colossus, 32800.0 souls (~32.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Walk up invisible, then hex and punch.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Rabbit Hex: its duration-scaled parts (hex duration 3s) get +22%.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 17,600-27,200 (levels 24-29). Your biggest single spirit hit (Vexing Bolt, max damage) grows from 196 to 258. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Cold Front.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Audience Participation copied ult window (9s), Spectral Assistant duration (13s), Vexing Bolt debuff duration (5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Cold Front
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Use it just before Rabbit Hex so they can't walk out of it.

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Hollow Point
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-46,400 (levels 29-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Vexing Bolt T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Vexing Bolt, max damage) grows from 258 to 444.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Colossus
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Reactive Barrier.
sections.desc: Dying after Fortitude? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Reactive Barrier.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming, like Grey Talon's or Lash's.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Silences and slowing hexes that stop you teleporting out.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Flyers and big ults. Also drops them right where you can hex.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: You keep dying right after the punch with no way out.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Vexing Bolt (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep catching you before the punch lands.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Instead of Hollow Point when you mostly catch one hero on their own.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Instead of Alchemical Fire when you keep dying in long fights. Hexed rabbits are easy heavy melee hits.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Audience Participation gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (85s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Indomitable
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Reactive Barrier for 4,800 more souls: cooldown reduction on proc 0 to 20; bullet resist 0 to 10..

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Rabbit Hex: resets its 16s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 16,000 invested, crossing the 11.2k, 16k tiers: bonus 52 to 66 spirit power. Replaces Alchemical Fire: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
